Are you a people leader with a strong programme and project management background? Do you excel at creating momentum, leading experienced project managers, and delivering complex transformation initiatives in a high-stakes environment?

As Senior Manager, Athene Programme, you will join the leadership team of the Athene Programme and take ownership of a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives across Supply Chain Management and Data Platform. You will lead a team of experienced project managers and play a key role in ensuring that projects are delivered successfully, while building a strong delivery culture and developing the people behind the delivery.

You will be expected to challenge stakeholders, create clarity in complexity, make decisions, remove obstacles, and help the organisation move forward. Success requires both strong leadership and strong execution capabilities.

What success will look like?

As Senior Manager, Athene Programme, you will be responsible for delivering business-critical transformation initiatives through others. Success is measured not only by project outcomes, but by your ability to build a high-performing team, create alignment across stakeholders, and drive execution in a complex international environment.

**During your first 6 months, we expect you to:

**

• Establish ownership of your project portfolio across the Supply Chain Management and Data Platform value streams.

• Build strong relationships with project managers, business leaders, IT stakeholders, and programme leadership.

• Create clarity around priorities, governance, delivery plans, risks, and dependencies.

• Put effective leadership and follow-up routines in place for the project managers reporting to you.

• Become a trusted sparring partner to the Programme Director and wider leadership team.

**Within your first year, you will have:

**

• Delivered key programme commitments according to agreed timelines and objectives.

• Built a motivated and high-performing team of project managers with clear accountability and ownership.

• Strengthened collaboration across Business Transformation, IT, and the business organisation.

• Established a strong delivery culture focused on transparency, execution, and shared accountability.

• Successfully supported major programme implementations and business readiness activities.

**In the longer term, you will:

**

• Build a project management capability that continues to create value beyond the Athene programme.

• Create an environment where talented project managers grow, develop, and choose to stay.

• Help strengthen STARK Group's overall transformation and delivery capabilities.

• Be recognised as a leader who turns complexity into tangible business results while bringing people along on the journey.

The role includes approximately 30-50 travel days annually across the Nordics.

Team, Reporting Line & Collaboration

You will report to Tommas Bjørnbak Tygesen, Programme Director and Vice President, and become part of the Athene Programme Leadership Team.

You will have direct people management responsibility for a team of experienced project managers, both internal and external, working across the Data Platform and Supply Chain Management value streams. Together, they are responsible for delivering some of the most important components of the Athene programme.

In your daily work, you will collaborate closely with Business Transformation, PMO, IT Delivery, value stream leads, business owners, and senior stakeholders across the Nordic organisation.

The role can be based either in Viby J (Aarhus) or Frederiksberg (Copenhagen). Regardless of your primary workplace, you should expect to travel to the other location approximately 1-2 times per month, typically for 2-3 days at a time, as your team and key stakeholders are based across both offices.

Who are we looking for?

You have likely built your career within project and programme management and are now motivated by leading people and creating results through others.

You know how to create structure without creating bureaucracy. You are comfortable making decisions, handling competing priorities, and maintaining momentum when things become complex. At the same time, you are a leader who builds trust. You challenge constructively, communicate clearly, and create accountability without creating fear. You are calm under pressure, pragmatic in your approach, and able to bring people together around a common goal.

It will be an advantage if you have experience with:

• Leading large-scale transformation programmes, ERP implementations, or business-critical change initiatives.

• Managing a portfolio of projects in an international matrix organisation.

• People leadership and development of project managers or similar delivery roles.

• Working across both business and IT environments.

• Programme governance, risk management, planning, and financial follow-up.

• Motivated by engaging with stakeholders in a value-driven and decentralised organisation

• Agile, waterfall, or hybrid delivery approaches.

• Relevant certifications such as PRINCE2, PMP, MSP, PgMP, SAFe, or similar.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who combines strong leadership with strong execution. Someone who can create clarity when complexity increases, make decisions when needed, and build a team that succeeds together.

Welcome to the Athene Programme

Athene is one of STARK Group's largest transformation programmes and plays a central role in building the future technology and business platform for the entire group.

You will join a leadership team characterised by trust, openness, and a strong sense of shared responsibility. Decisions are often made through collaboration, relationships, and influence rather than hierarchy, making this an exciting opportunity for leaders who thrive in decentralised environments.

The pace is high, ambitions are significant, and change is constant. At the same time, you will join a team that genuinely supports one another and believes that long-term success is created together.

Want to know more and apply?

We are happy to answer any questions you may have regarding the position and your opportunities at STARK Group. For questions regarding the role, please contact Tommas Bjørnbak Tygesen, Programme Director and Vice President, at tommas.tygesen@stark.dk

We are looking for someone to join as soon as possible and will conduct interviews on an ongoing basis until the right candidate has been found.

STARK Group

STARK Group is a growing private equity-owned company with a strong legacy. STARK Group was first established in Denmark in 1896 and has today evolved into a leading European retailer and distributor of heavy building materials with net sales of approx. EUR 9 billion. With a dedicated team of more than 20,000 employees and +1,150 branches and distribution centres across the Nordics, Greenland, Germany, Austria and the UK, we live and breathe to serve professional craftsmen with heavy building materials all the way from the Austrian Alps to Tromsø, close to the Arctic circle and everywhere in between.

STARK Group is committed to reach net zero emissions by 2050 across the entire business, is a signatory to the UN Global Compact, and works within fully 2030 validated science-based targets to keep global warming below 1.5°C At STARK Group IT, we believe in the richness diversity brings. We invite individuals of all backgrounds to join us in creating and inclusive and welcoming environment. We believe in a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work.

**Agency Policy

**STARK Group IT appreciates the interest of all candidates. However, we prefer to directly engage with individuals seeking employment opportunities. Therefore, we kindly request recruitment agencies, headhunters, and third-party staffing services to refrain from contacting us regarding this job posting. All applications should be submitted directly by the candidates through our official application process. We value direct communication and look forward to reviewing your application.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role

We’re looking for a proactive and curious student worker to join our Public Affairs Europe team. This is a unique opportunity to step into a highly visible role where personality, initiative, and strong interpersonal skills matter just as much as experience. In this role, you will support political engagement across multiple European markets, stakeholder coordination, and the operational excellence that makes strategic work possible.

You will gain direct exposure to a leading oncology biotech’s European policy landscape, develop insight into pharmaceutical policy and political strategy, and experience the dynamics of multi-market stakeholder engagement. At the same time, you will build hands-on experience in vendor management, procurement processes, and contract administration.

We are a small and agile team in Europe, currently the only Public Affairs presence in the region, working closely with colleagues in the US and across markets. This role is ideal for someone who is a self-starter, confident in sharing ideas, and not afraid to speak up. You enjoy working with others, building relationships, and navigating different stakeholders with empathy and strong communication skills. We offer flexibility around exams and study schedules, and an inclusive, supportive team environment where you are encouraged to grow and contribute from day one. Intended start date: 1 / 15 May.

Help us get to know you by submitting a comprehensive application, including your CV and motivational letter!

Responsibilities

Public Affairs

• Helping the team stay on top of political developments and initiatives across Europe.

• Supporting contact with different stakeholders like governments, patient organisations, and health authorities.

• Assisting in organising meetings and roundtables with external partners across European markets.

• Helping prepare clear and simple summaries, briefings, and communication materials.

• Supporting the organisation of events and conferences.

Operations & Administration

• Assisting with setting up and managing suppliers (vendors)

• Helping out with day-to-day administrative tasks where needed

• Supporting budget tracking and keeping an overview of costs

• Assisting with purchase orders and procurement processes

• Helping manage contracts and agreements

Requirements

• Actively enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program with approximately 2 years remaining before graduation.

• Based in Denmark, with a background in Political Science, Business, Public Health, Communications, or a related social science.

• Motivated by both political engagement and high-quality administrative execution.

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-directed.

• Comfortable working with spreadsheets and managing processes efficiently.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken, as it's Genmab's primary language.

• Available for approximately 20 hours per week.

About You

• You are genuinely passionate about our purpose

• You bring precision and excellence to all that you do

• You believe in our rooted-in-science approach to problem-solving

• You are a generous collaborator who can work in teams with a broad spectrum of backgrounds

• You take pride in enabling the best work of others on the team

• You can grapple with the unknown and be innovative

• You have experience working in a fast-growing, dynamic company (or a strong desire to)

• You work hard and are not afraid to have a little fun while you do so!

Locations

Genmab maximizes the efficiency of an agile working environment, when possible, for the betterment of employee work-life balance. Our offices are crafted as open, community-based spaces that work to connect employees while being immersed in our powerful laboratories. Whether you’re in one of our office spaces or working remotely, we thrive on connecting with each other to innovate.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

About Us

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose guiding its unstoppable team to strive towards improving the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For more than 20 years, its passionate, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and leveraged translational research and data sciences, which has resulted in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators, effector function enhanced antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates. To help develop and deliver novel antibody therapies to patients, Genmab has formed 20+ strategic partnerships with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO™) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with locations in Utrecht, the Netherlands, Princeton, New Jersey, U.S. and Tokyo, Japan.

Are you passionate about recruitment and eager to gain hands-on experience in the field of People and Culture? Do you want to enhance your skills in recruitment while fostering employee engagement and well-being? Are you ready to join an international green-tech company where your ideas can truly make a difference for people?

Here is what your role entails

During your internship, you will play an important role in driving a people-focused recruitment process and ensuring a great experience for every candidate. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to explore other areas within People & Culture, based on your interests and career aspirations.

More specifically, you will be:

• Partnering with hiring managers throughout the recruitment process from A-Z

• Taking ownership of the for recruiting new the Interns for the Spring semester of 2027

• Conducting qualitative and quantitative surveys and providing the P&C with data-based insights

• Supporting onboarding activities, and helping create engaging internship experience in social events and courses throughout the internship program

You will experience the freedom to explore your interests and take ownership of your own projects, giving you valuable insight into how People & Culture works in practice. With a thorough onboarding and continuous guidance from your mentor, we will support you throughout your entire internship.

Meet your future team

In this role you will become a part of our P&C Global Excellence & Operations team consisting of 16 talented colleagues. We are a tight-knit group working collaboratively to attract and hire candidates while ensuring the smooth operation of our global P&C processes. You will be part of a skilled, dynamic, and diverse team that values personal development, initiative, and collaboration, supporting each other to bring out the best in both the team and the organization.

Did you know? We have a previous Danish champion in Pétanque on our team, and 6 of us started our journey in Kamstrup as Interns.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for an Intern who is ready to contribute to Kamstrup’s recruitment efforts and help drive our global recruitment and P&C initiatives. You may not have much experience yet, but the most important thing is that you are motivated to make your mark within our people operations.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying a master´s degree in Business Administration, Psychology, Educational Science or another relevant field

• Thrive in a communicating role, enabling you to establish good professional collaborations

• Have a structured and analytical approach to your work

• Can work independently, and like having responsibility for your own tasks

• Are curious and eager to learn, and bring a positive mindset to new challenges and collaborations

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English and Danish.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• A gratuity which may be provided in recognition of your efforts if your place of study allows it as well as paid public transportation to and from work

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact People Consultant, Emma Bak Andersen, on telephone nr.: +45 89 93 10 00.

We are looking for a Solution Architect to drive the development and evolution of our Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations template and help shape a modern, scalable, and future-ready ERP landscape.

In this role, you will take ownership of design, maintenance, and continuous improvement of our ERP template across our global organization focusing on D365F&O in our sales- and customer service area. You will play a key role in ensuring high-quality, business-aligned solutions that support our sales and product initiatives. Furthermore, you will work at the intersection of business and technology, where standardization, optimization, and innovation go hand in hand with collaboration, trust, and continuous learning.

As a Solution Architect, you will bring together business needs, technical expertise, and structured processes to deliver stable, scalable, and user-focused ERP solutions. You will work closely with our colleagues in international sales and customer facing (web shop, CRM) and take ownership from ideas through implementation and support, ensuring alignment with business goals and long-term application roadmaps.

If you choose to join us, you will be working with the newest technologies, take on new challenges that will broaden your role and profile and potentially make you relevant for other opportunities within Demant IT in the long run.

**Welcome to Hearing Aids IT – ERP Solutions

**You will join Demant’s Hearing Aids (HA) IT organization, part of Global IT, consisting of around 265 talented professionals working together to enable innovation, reliability, and security across Demant’s global IT operations. Within this, you will be part of the ERP Solutions department, which consists of approximately 90 people (colleagues and external consultants). You will report to the Manager for ERP Design & Architecture and work closely with a team of solution architects and application architects.

**Drive DFO Template Design and Development

**In this role, you will take ownership of the HA Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations template withing the sales- and customer service area and ensure its continuous development, stability, and alignment with business needs and the rest of the areas. You will work closely with stakeholders, other architects, deployment teams, and support functions across regions.

By joining us, you will step into a key role where your expertise will directly impact our global ERP landscape. In this role, you will:

• Create and review functional design specifications within your area of responsibility, ready for development and/or technical specification

• Own HA Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Template changes from design to successful acceptance testing within the sales- and customer service area

• Lead template maintenance initiatives, including design and prioritization

• Work closely with other Solution Architects from Global IT to ensure solution alignment across the IT landscape within our sales domain

• Collaborate with deployment and support teams to define resource needs for testing and training in our sites

• Proactively inform management about risks, challenges, and concerns related to new functionality deployments

• Identify opportunities for improvement and lead initiatives from ideas to implementation

• Act as 3rd-level support within your area of responsibility

• Work with our product teams on Hearing Aid product launches to understand requirements for our systems, ensuring proper design and testing of changes with their products.

• Support key decisionmakers in defining and implementing optimal solutions across the Demant Group

• Contribute to application roadmaps and support execution by identifying risks, required competencies, and inputs to project plans

You can expect approximately 20 days of travel per year, visiting our site in Somerset (USA) and other sites.

**What You Bring

**You hold relevant education within IT, business, or a related field – or bring equivalent practical experience.

You bring 3–4 years of experience as a Solution Architect working with Microsoft ERP solutions, particularly Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, within a larger enterprise environment.

In addition, you bring a combination of business and technical insight within the sales area, along with a business mindset and the ability to translate requirements into scalable, effective solutions. You are a problem-solver who can navigate complexity, and you possess good facilitation, discovery, analysis, and prototyping skills.

Hopefully, you also have experience or familiarity with the Unified pricing module and Microsoft technologies such as Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate), Azure DevOps, AI tools (Copilot, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, or similar).

**Come and join us

**We value collaboration, openness, and accountability, and we believe results are created through trust, inclusion, and continuous learning.

Send your CV before October 31st, 2026. We review applications continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For inquiries regarding the application process, please use the online application form.

If you would like to know more about the position, you are welcome to contact Manager for ERP Design & Architecture, Marcus Nötzel at marn@demant.com.

We look forward to hearing from you.

**Recruitment Process Information:

**We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible. Selected candidates will be invited to first-round interviews throughout October, followed by second-round interviews in November.

_At Demant we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

Do you want to work for an Architectural Firm with sustainability at the heart of its strategy? Can you contribute with solutions from your academic studies? Are you currently studying to be an Construction Architecture (Bygningskonstruktør)? Then, join us to shape a sustainable and liveable world.

About us

Arkitema was established in 1969 making us one of Denmark's oldest architectural firms. Today, we are well positioned in Scandinavia with offices in Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

In our markets we provide wide range of competencies in our areas of expertise. We cover sectors and disciplines like healthcare, industry, transformation, landscape and residential construction.

Since 2019 Arkitema has been part of COWI, one of Scandinavia’s leading engineering and consultancy companies. Together with customers, partners and colleagues, we shape a future where people and societies grow and flourish. We do that by co-creating more sustainable and beautiful solutions that improve the quality of life for people today and many generations ahead.

Create Solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

As an intern at Arkitema, you will be part of a design team in one of Scandinavia's largest and leading architectural firms, where you will work with experienced architects, construction architects, urban planners and engineers to solve a wide range of professionally relevant tasks.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• To use your academic knowledge of technical fundamentals to contribute to our projects

• Gain valuable experience in the field of architecture and construction

Also, you will be included in a team and assigned an experienced colleague as a mentor who will guide you throughout your internship. We carry out architecture primarily throughout the Nordic region but also other parts of the world within the areas of; Housing, Learning, Business, Health, Urban, Culture and Infrastructure. Therefore, our assignments range from small preservation-worthy residential neighborhoods to complex super hospitals, bridges and cultural centers.

As an intern, you will have the opportunity to be involved in drawing the first lines, registering old building masses, supervising construction sites on ongoing projects, or modeling and detailing the many complex buildings. Our professional span will give you a broad understanding of the design profession and in-depth knowledge of the workflows in the construction industry.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners, or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you’ll have:

• Actively pursuing a bachelor’s degree in architectural technology and construction management (Bygningskonstruktør)

• Have good problem-solving skills

• Be a creative and technical thinker

• Be able to demonstrate evidence of research and information gathering skills

Professional development

We strive to develop talented interns who graduate with a high level of professional skills. As part of the internship at Arkitema, there are ongoing presentations where our own specialists share their experience and best practices in topics such as:

• Sustainability, materials & reuse

• BIM, Revit, design & sketching

• Client consultancy & tendering

• Restoration & building preservation

• Competitions & visualizations

• Descriptions & quality assurance

• Urban Planning

These topics represent important knowledge and practical insights that will ensure you stand stronger in your future career.

A place to work and so much more

At Arkitema, we work together with our customers to shape sustainable and customized solutions. By making use of our collective knowledge and curiosity, we create opportunities that contribute to good solutions for a future with ever-changing needs.

We want to develop an environment where curiosity, belonging and good chemistry are in focus.

For us, it is important that the people we share everyday work with are allowed to be themselves, precisely because it is what brings out the best in you and those around us, both at work and at home.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role, please reach out Jacob Faaborg-Simonsen – jafs@arkitema.com for Aarhus/Aalborg and Adrian Balch Petersen – adpn@arkitema.com for Copenhagen.

Get to know us even better at our website, Arkitema where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at Arkitema.

We focus on creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equal opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are considered valuable. We also take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes when we put together teams and forums. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

**Do you want to play a key role in some of Denmark’s largest and most complex energy infrastructure projects? Are you an experienced planner who creates structure, transparency, and progress in complex projects? Then join us at COWI and help shape the future of sustainable energy infrastructure.

**

**Become a vital part of our Energy team

**

As a Senior Planner, you will play a key role in planning and delivering large and complex energy and infrastructure projects. In this role, you will work at Energinet as part of a COWI team supporting some of Energinet’s important projects. You will take ownership of project schedules and work closely with project managers, technical specialists, contractors and suppliers to create transparency, manage dependencies and risks, and keep projects moving forward.

Furthermore, you will support projects throughout their lifecircle – from early development and design through tendering and execution. Beyond maintaining schedules, you will function as a trusted sparring partner to project management, using planning and schedule analysis to support informed decision-making, identify challenges and drive corrective actions. Through your work at Energinet, you will gain the opportunity to contribute directly to projects that are central to Denmark’s energy infrastructure and green transition.

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarter in Lyngby.

**Your key responsibilities

**

As a Senior Planner, you will:

• Develop, maintain, and optimise integrated project schedules using Primavera OPC and MS Project.

• Monitor project progress together with project managers and technical leads, identify deviations and support corrective actions.

• Identify and manage critical paths, dependencies, interfaces, and schedule risks across project activities.

• Perform baseline management, what-if analyses and schedule risk assessments.

• Review and validate schedules from contractors, suppliers, and other project partners.

• Prepare clear progress and status reports, providing transparency on milestones, risks, dependencies, and deviations.

• Ensure schedules support effective progress, risk, and resource management.

• Contribute to the development and implementation of robust planning methodologies, processes, and tools across our projects.

• Provide planning expertise and constructive challenge to project management and project teams.

**Your skills. Our team. Together, we design the future.

**

You are an experienced and proactive planner who is comfortable taking ownership of complex project schedules. You understand that good planning is about more than maintaining a programme – you use the schedule to create transparency, challenge assumptions, identify risks and support project management in making informed decisions.

**Description

**Factbird helps manufacturers turn real-time production data into decisions they can actually act on. Since 2016, we've helped manufacturers in 28 countries cut waste, boost uptime, and run smarter — from the shop floor to the boardroom. Over 300 companies trust us to make sense of their operations, and we're a team of 80+ people across Copenhagen and the US who care about making complex things simple.

We're creating a new role at the top of our Engineering career ladder: Lead Architect. It's the senior end of our Technical Track — the rung above Tech Lead — and today it's a role we've deliberately left lightly defined, because we want the first person in it to help define it. You'll set Factbird's technical direction: architecture, tooling, and the multi-year technology bets that shape where the product goes next.

This is our most senior technical role, with no direct reports — your authority comes from judgment and track record, not the org chart. You'll work alongside our Tech Leads in Factbird's technical leadership group, partner closely with our Director of Engineering, and be the person other senior engineers go to when a decision is genuinely hard to reverse.

**About the Role

**As Lead Architect, you own Factbird's company-wide technical vision: the architecture our services run on, the tooling and standards our engineers use every day, and the multi-year technology strategy that ties it all together. You make — or sign off on — the high-stakes, hard-to-reverse architecture calls, and you're accountable for getting them right with the full context of where the business is headed, not just where the code is today.

You'll work across a team built on Rust, React, Node.js, and AWS, with AI-assisted development already a core part of how we ship. Some of what this role owns is already well-defined — reviewing RFCs, stewarding language and platform standards, setting the team's AI-tooling strategy. Some of it isn't yet: Factbird is still a growing company, and part of the job is helping us figure out what technical leadership at this level should look like as we scale.

You'll thrive here if you'd rather be trusted with genuinely hard calls than manage a team, and if you can hold both the technical detail and the commercial context — cost, risk, market direction — well enough to make a technology bet you can still defend a year later.

**

What you'll do

**Architecture & technical strategy

• Own Factbird's multi-year technology strategy, and make the high-stakes architecture calls that are hard to reverse — with cost, risk, and business context factored in, not just engineering elegance

• Author and drive major RFCs from proposal through to an actual decision, and review the highest-risk architecture changes across the team

• Act as steward for our core languages and frameworks — setting standards, library choices, and the platform's overall shape

• Make build-vs-buy calls for new technical capabilities, and bring a clear point of view on emerging technologies worth adopting

• Define the observability, reliability, and security posture the platform is held to

**

Tooling & standards**

• Set the team's technical tooling and platform standards, and keep them evolving as the stack and the company grow

• Define Factbird's strategy for AI-assisted development — which tools we adopt, how we balance velocity against code quality, security, and IP risk, and where we draw the line

• Shape engineering-wide quality philosophy and help set the technical bar used in hiring interviews

• Help define shared components and reference architecture that other engineers build on, rather than reinvent

• Give input into technical org design and team topology as Engineering scales

**

Technical leadership & mentorship**

• Act as the trusted technical advisor to our Director of Engineering and the technical leadership group, partnering with Tech Leads and Product Leads on cross-team alignment

• Mentor senior engineers and Tech Leads toward architect-level thinking, without formal ownership of their people management

• Communicate technical vision and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including leadership

• Identify technical risks to the business early, and say so before they become expensive

• Represent Factbird's technical thinking externally where it makes sense — a talk, a blog post, an open-source contribution — though this isn't a requirement on day one

**What we’re looking for

**We're looking for someone who's already earned this kind of trust somewhere else — someone whose technical opinions carry weight because they're right more often than not, and who'd rather solve the interesting, ambiguous problem than manage the team solving it.

**

The ideal background**

• 8+ years of hands-on engineering experience, including real time spent as an architect or equivalent senior technical authority, not just a senior engineer with a bigger title

• A track record of owning multi-year technology strategy or platform architecture decisions that other teams had to live with — and that held up

• Has led major RFCs or architecture proposals cross-team, through genuine pushback, to an actual decision

• Comfortable making build-vs-buy and technology-adoption calls that account for cost, risk, and where the market is heading, not just what's technically interesting

• Experience mentoring senior engineers or Tech Leads toward architect-level thinking, without needing formal authority to do it

• Practical, current experience with AI-assisted development, and a clear point of view on where it genuinely helps versus where it creates risk

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

**

Here's what you can look forward to:**

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn't one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We'll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we'll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide gatherings & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what's next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We're proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

We'd love to hear from you

Composite Process Engineer for FirePoint Rocket Technology – Denmark

FirePoint Rocket Technology (FPRT) is building one of the most unique and strategically important industrial projects in Denmark – a brand new production facility for solid rocket propellant and advanced defense-tech components. Our ambition is significant: we are scaling from the early operational phase to 300+ employees within the next 18 months.

We are looking for a Composite Process Engineer who will ensure that our composite manufacturing processes are safe, stable, repeatable, and ready for serial production. You will report directly to our Senior Composite Process Technology Manager and collaborate closely with Production, Quality, Materials, HSE, and Maintenance.

Professional and Operational Skills

• Hands-on experience with processes such as resin infusion/transfer, filament winding, lay-up, prepreg, molding, curing, or composite machining/finishing.

• Proven experience creating or improving SOPs, work instructions, and manufacturing standards.

• Background in industrialization, production ramp-up, technology transfer, or process stabilization.

• Strong problem-solving skills with a mindset for root-cause analysis (e.g., FMEA, 5 Whys).

The Ideal Candidate

We are seeking a proactive engineer who combines strong technical capabilities with a practical understanding of production. You thrive on being close to the shop floor, working with operators to ensure that process standards are practical, understood, and followed. You are motivated by establishing structure and stability in a dynamic Greenfield environment, and you maintain a clear perspective—even when working under tight deadlines in an accelerating growth phase.

Join us in building the foundation of next generation hearing device platforms.

_Are you passionate about firmware close to the metal? Do you enjoy understanding how hardware really works and applying your expertise to build stable, efficient real time embedded systems? Would you like your work to make a real difference for millions of people living with hearing loss worldwide?

If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

About The Team

You will join our Foundation Firmware area within the R&D Device SW organization — a group of about 25 highly skilled engineers working in three scrum teams. Together we build and maintain the low level firmware that forms the foundation of all Demant hearing device software platforms.

We work closely with hardware, software and production teams throughout every stage of platform development. The atmosphere in the team is informal, friendly, and highly engaged. We believe the best results come from a fruitful team effort. We support each other, provide constructive feedback, and share knowledge and ideas to continuously improve our solutions and reach common goals.

What You Will Be Working On

Our work spans the full development flow of a resource-constrained platform — from IC specification and early bring-up, through development, verification, and production, all the way to product release. This means working in simulations, on FPGA prototypes, and on real silicon as our platforms mature. Our chipsets are internally developed, multi-core network-on-chip solutions designed for ultra-low-power audio. Our firmware platform includes hardware drivers and HAL, RTOS integration, power management, file handling, communication stacks, security, firmware update functionality and more.

You will design, develop, test, and release firmware for our custom ICs, working closely with other embedded software, hardware, production, and verification teams. Your focus will be on delivering advanced functionality with real-time guarantees for the system, while always balancing memory consumption, compute cycles, and power efficiency to meet the high standards of medical devices. This means writing safe, efficient C code that enables our hearing devices to perform reliably in highly resource-constrained environments. You will use and help improve specialized in-house tools that assist the development process, as well as automated regression tests that safeguard stability and performance of our platform as it evolves.

In summary, your main responsibilities will be to:

• 
Design, develop and test efficient firmware for our chipset platform

• 
Support hardware and production teams in bring up, calibration and verification

• 
Contribute to the definition and development of our internally developed ICs

• 
Implement safe and efficient C code for real time applications

• 
Help ensure high quality through automated tests and CI/CD

• 
Participate in team ceremonies and knowledge sharing

What You Bring

You hold a degree in Electronics, Computer Engineering, or similar, and you have a solid hands-on experience – at least 3 years – within the following areas of embedded SW development:

• 
Embedded C programming for memory , power and time constrained systems

• 
Understanding of processor architectures and MCUs

• 
Real time operating systems (RTOS) and real-time handling of HW

• 
Reading HW schematics

• 
Working with measurement instruments such as logic analyzers or oscilloscopes

• 
Automated unit and system testing

• 
Version control systems (git)

• 
Linux, scripting and custom toolchains

You take pride in building high-quality, maintainable code and are comfortable working in large, shared code repositories with comprehensive testing and a complex build flow. You can work independently, but you also enjoy collaborating within the team and across teams to achieve the best results.

Why Demant?

At Demant, we believe in balancing professional passion with a fulfilling personal life. Our flexible hybrid work model allows you to work from home up to two days per week. Each morning, you can enjoy complimentary breakfast, and lunch is provided daily in our canteen. To support your well-being, you will have access to fitness facilities, weekly training sessions, and massage services. If you are parent, we offer attractive parental benefits, including the option to stay home when your young child is unwell. Above all, we prioritize a respectful and inclusive workplace culture where colleagues support one another, and everyone feels valued.

How To Apply

This is a full time position located at our headquarters in Smørum, Greater Copenhagen area. (Please note: We are not considering part time, consultant, or internship contracts for this role.)

Please submit your CV and a short motivation via our online portal no later than October 30th, 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis. If you have questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Maja Lončar, Senior Manager System Firmware, at mjln@demant.com.

We expect to conduct first-round interviews in weeks 44-45 and second-round interviews in weeks 45-46.

At Demant we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.
